rootCause.wrongValueObserved: ADMIN stripe create calls: 1 | upsert.create.priceSnapshot: undefined | upsert.update.priceSnapshot: undefined | prisma models touched: ["tenant","tenantAddon","tenantSubscription"]  ||  SELF enable emits: [["addon.enabled",24]] | prisma models touched: ["tenantAddon","$transaction"]  ||  SELF disable emits (stored snapshot=10, catalog=12, qty=2): [["addon.disabled",-24]]
rootCause.note:
I reproduced the bug on the current tree (branch fix/b863-b866-billing-mrr-ledger) with a throwaway Jest probe. The probe lives only in the scratchpad (scratchpad/probe/rc865.spec.ts) and ran through `npx jest --roots <scratchpad>` from apps/api. I changed no repo files.

Admin path, apps/api/src/billing/addon.service.ts: I called enableAddon("t1","msrp","price_x") with Stripe configured and stripeSubId "sub_1".
- The Stripe subscription item was created (1 call), so the add-on is billed.
- The upsert at :246-260 has priceSnapshot undefined in both create and update.
- The only Prisma models the call touched were tenant, tenantAddon and tenantSubscription. There was no billingEvent and no $transaction.
- The constructor takes 6 arguments (:48-55) and none of them is a BillingEventService.
- The named cause is confirmed: no priceSnapshot, no emit, no transaction. With a null snapshot, MrrService prices the add-on at $0. That $0 is from the cause-brief (mrr.service.ts:237-239); this probe did not run MrrService.

Self-serve path, apps/api/src/billing/subscription-mutation.service.ts: I used FORECASTING, a self-service SKU, with catalog price 12 and quantity 2.
- enableAddon emitted ADDON_ENABLED with amountDelta 24. The only models it read were tenantAddon and $transaction, so there is no tenant-status or isPayingRow check before the emit (:1259-1265). It would book for a TRIAL tenant too.
- disableAddon on a row with stored priceSnapshot 10 booked -24, which is minus the catalog price (12×2), not -20 from the stored snapshot. This confirms :1322 prices from the catalog and :1324-1329 emits without a gate.
- These match the test-plan wrong values [24] and -24 for T12/T13.

Discrepancy: the brief's probe `-t "REG-ADMIN-ADDON-MRR"` does not exist at HEAD. A grep of apps/ and packages/ found no match. The cause-brief attributes it to commit 7c3a5d61, which is not on this tree. So I could not run the named probe, and the scratch probe above stands in for it.

Not verified: whether production has any admin add-on rows priced with a stripePriceId (the registry says latent). I did not run anything against a database.
